title: The siege, the dawn assault and the ridge camp

entries.title: The siege
entries.text: Raiders are marching on the village with a ram and a catapult. Man the walls before they arrive, then send Captain Hale to burn their siege engines, or let his people try.

entries.title: The dawn assault
entries.text: The morning after. The raiders' smaller band comes back. If they took the captain, you have only a short while to break him out, pay for him or leave him behind.

entries.title: The ridge camp
entries.text: The raiders fall back to a camp on the ridge with a new ram. Their stores are within reach for a while.
